requirements.description: Inspect filled copper, source-return attachments and vias; exclude load current from narrow sense branches and quantify two-terminal shunt sensing error.
Review conductor, pad entry, via, shunt and FET capacity for normal 2A pulses and actual hard-short peaks; width alone is not ampacity.
Verify switching ground bounce, sense response, overcurrent latency and short-circuit SOA using bound component models and routed geometry.
Calibrate current readings, test overload/fault response and measure shunt/amplifier temperature and interference under the actual load.
